aer.text: Tezzeret made the Aether Spire his secret base, having Rashmi expand her device into the Planar Bridge, powered by aether from the Aether Hub.
Tezzeret completed the Planar Bridge, declaring that the real work could begin.
Liliana tried to assassinate Tezzeret while Chandra, shielded by Gideon, destroyed the Planar Bridge with a fireblast, and Tezzeret escaped with the portal's core.

clu.text: The arrival of the Planar Bridge caused eddies in the aether, creating some entirely new species while transforming others.
